_note: A9 (2026-10-08 ET, D23 G6): ground check decal for a LOCKED pad. Art-owned. Rebuild: python3 make_pad_decal_a9.py . (deterministic, numpy + Pillow).
content: Top-down ground stencil, centred, transparent. Ink #F4F1EA ring (r 0.425 of size, stroke 0.038) + check mark (stroke 0.09, round caps), 0.022 dark keyline #07080D @72 %, soft dark disc #07080D @38 % (r 0.47) as a contrast pocket. Light paint wear (alpha 0.86-1.0). No pad hue: reads as 'done' on cyan, gold, pink fill and on bare asphalt.

draw.image: Load the @2x file only and scale it down; drawImage(img, cx - s/2, cy - s/2, s, s) in world space (inside the camera transform).

centre.drift: INTER.x, INTER.y (r 360 -> decal = 0.25 of the ring diameter, sits in the hub junction)
centre.donut: DONUT.x, DONUT.y (r 90 -> 0.67 of the pad diameter)
centre.burnout: BURNOUT centre (240x140 box -> 0.79 of its height)

draw.blend: source-over (globalCompositeOperation default). Not screen/lighter: the dark keyline must darken bright pad fill.
draw.order: After the pad fill + ring/stroke (and after the locked-pad desaturate), BEFORE the world labels, guide arrow, skids, smoke, crowd, traffic, cops and the hero car. I.e. under the car, over the pad fill. In PLAY-THIS draw() that is right before the ALLEY box line `ctx.fillStyle="rgba(90,255,150,.2)"; ctx.fillRect(ALLEY.x,...`.
draw.lock_in_anim_optional: 0.25 s ease-out: scale 1.3 -> 1.0, alpha 0 -> 0.9, from the lock moment. Static afterwards. Hidden on the end card like other world art (it is world art, so it shows in replay frames only if pads draw there).

locked_pad_desaturate_suggestion.rule: Locked pad colour = mix(pad rgb, muted #9AA3B5, 0.75), alpha x0.6. Keeps a 25 % hint of the pad identity so the order still reads.
locked_pad_desaturate_suggestion.cyan_ring: rgba(131,178,199,0.45)  (was rgba(62,224,255,0.75)); the existing C27 green lock ring is Code/Design's call

preview: art/kit/a9-preview/a9-gold10-locked.png, a9-block045-locked.png, a9-pink10-locked.png (mock: canvas 'saturation' composite for the desat + this decal at the sizes above)
